entity_raw.definition_raw: Ferocity SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): StrengthAssociated Deities: Abhoth, Alocer, Ananshea, Ayrzul, Baphomet, Bohga, Cayden Cailean, Charg, Cihua Couatl, Ealdeez, Geryon, Gorum, Guyuku, Hadregash, Haggakal, Kostchtchie, Lamashtu, Llamolaek, Malacoda, Minderhal, Nightripper, Nulgreth, Sabnach, Sicva, Sobek, Szuriel, Urazra, Urgathoa, Uskyeria, Xoveron, Zevgavizeb, ZipacnaReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the strength surge power of the Strength domain. Ferocious Strike (Su): Whenever you make a melee attack, you can designate that attack as a ferocious strike. If the attack hits, it deals additional damage equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum +1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 3rd—rage, 6th—bull’s strength (mass).
